free_tier.stated: keyless REST API answering JSON, rate limited to 3 requests a second; the User-Agent header must have the form keycdn-tools:https://your-site; data from MaxMind GeoLite
free_tier.notes: no daily or monthly quota is stated; a request with a missing or invalid User-Agent is blocked.

per_object_cap.stated: one host name or IP address per request (the host parameter)

egress.terms: not applicable: JSON answers, not metered in bytes

interface_detail: GET https://tools.keycdn.com/geo.json?host={ip or hostname} answers JSON; the User-Agent header names the calling site in the form keycdn-tools:https://example.com
tooling: curl with the User-Agent header shown in the page's example
chaining: Keyless MaxMind GeoLite city and ASN lookups at 3 requests a second; one host per request. Bulk path: none.
binding_note: 3 requests a second is the only published cap; no daily or monthly quota is stated.

identity_cost.detail: no key and no account; a User-Agent header naming the calling site is required

reliability_note: requests without a valid keycdn-tools User-Agent are blocked, and the page says the service is rate limited to avoid overload
confidence_note: A keyless lookup of 8.8.8.8 with the User-Agent form from the page's own example was probed on 2026-11-02 and returned HTTP 200; the rate limit is quoted from the page and was not exhausted.

evidence.proved: the REST API answers JSON and is rate limited to 3 requests a second
evidence.quote: Get the IP geolocation data through the simple REST API. All the responses are JSON encoded. We are rate limiting requests (3r/s) to avoid overload of the system.

evidence.proved: a User-Agent header naming the calling site is required
evidence.quote: It is required to set the request header `User-Agent` in the format `keycdn-tools:https?://.*`, which must include the website you are using the API for.

evidence.proved: a missing or invalid User-Agent is blocked
evidence.quote: Missing attributions or invalid values will be blocked.

evidence.proved: the data comes from MaxMind GeoLite
evidence.quote: This product includes GeoLite Data created by MaxMind, available from [https://www.maxmind.com](https://www.maxmind.com/).

evidence.proved: the documented call is a GET of /geo.json with a host parameter and the User-Agent header
a keyless GET of /geo.json?host=8.8.8.8 with the documented User-Agent form answered HTTP 200
the answer carries ASN, ISP and country

notes: Free requests: no quota stated; 3 requests a second. Rate limit: 3 per second. Bulk path: none; one host per request.
